Name: The Fox's Teeth
Description: McKinnon's Company, better known as McKinnon's Raiders or The Fox's Teeth, was a special operations BattleMech company. Originally a Star League Defense Force combat unit, the company defected to House Davion at the breakup of the League. During the next three hundred years, as an independent part of the Seventh Crucis Lancers the Raiders became one of the most famous commands of the Federated Suns
ReputationStatements: We have a job for you, Mercenary scum. As distasteful as that is to us.
Mercenary though you may be, you seem effective enough. House Davion has need of your skills, Commander.
Greetings, Commander. House Davion requires aid from someone outside of our own forces. Hopefully you can help us.
House Davion requires mercenaries of skill, Commander, and you fit the bill nicely. With luck, we will both profit from this arrangement.
You have served us well in the past, Commander. We value this relationship, and would like to preserve it.
Greetings, Commander. Once again, House Davion requires your services. Should you be successful, we will both profit.
Honored friend! Your acts in service to House Davion have not been forgotten. In light of this, we present you with this choice contract.
MissionSuccessStatements: Excellent performance, Commander. The Federated Suns are pleased with what you have accomplished and the skill you've evidenced. Expect our payment in full!
GoodFaithFailureStatements: Well, let it never be said House Davion does not believe in charity. Obviously, your skills could not be equivalent to our own regular armies—so we do not blame you for your inability to complete the contract.
BadFaithFailureStatements: Come now, mercenary—did you even try to complete the contract, or did you believe we'd pay you for your own inadequacies? Such a dismal performance cannot be rewarded, only reprimanded.
